forbidden: Reading cached, historical or pre-created JSON as the current CLI result.
Skipping result-schema validation for either invocation.
Accepting exit code alone, an ID substring, file existence or plan status as proof.
Omitting either the reference-pass or mutated-package-rejection assertion.
Deriving expected status or required diagnostic values from candidate-controlled policy.
Treating an import error, missing file, environment failure or timeout as causal RED.
Treating derived validation output as execution authorization.
